source_text:
Make a 10-second vertical ad for Toffee Coffee Roasters' Ethiopia Speciality
Instant Coffee. It should feel premium, warm and unmistakably Indian specialty coffee.
Open with a strong hook, reveal the pack, show the coffee's energy, then land the brand
and a clear call to action. Use a 9:16 frame for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, with
captions for sound-off viewing. Use only approved product facts, price and promotion
details, and do not reuse any reference video footage. The production planning cap is
USD 60.
title: Toffee Coffee Roasters - Ethiopia, in an instant
objective: Introduce the Ethiopia Speciality Instant Coffee in ten seconds and drive a qualified click to the product page.
audience: Indian urban coffee drinkers aged 25-40 who already buy specialty coffee online, plus existing Toffee customers and small gift buyers. Inferred from the INR storefront and range; confirm with the brand.
subject: speciality instant coffee
series_pattern: one-off hero ad; optional three-variant test later
constraints: Captions must carry the story with sound off
No price, offer or claim unless an approved exact-data record exists
No reference video footage may be reused
Paid asset generation belongs to Level 2, not Level 1
One hero cut; no variant is required for this test
avoid: hard-sell discount language before the brand reveal
assumptions: The audience is inferred from the INR storefront and specialty range.
Reels and Shorts safe areas are operator assumptions until placement specs are confirmed.
No brand font or brand guideline was supplied; Inter (SIL OFL 1.1) is a documented placeholder.
rights_notes: Storefront pack imagery and the logo are brand property. Their presence on the public site does not grant advertising use. Reference Shorts are inspiration only.

must_have.text: Strong opening hook in the first two seconds
Reveal the Ethiopia Speciality Instant Coffee pack
Show coffee energy: liquid, macro texture and steam
Land the Toffee brand and a clear call to action
Captions that work with sound off
Only approved product facts, price and promotion
No reuse of reference video footage
